baseline: H0: res60s1 with causal EWMA alpha=0.25
B00: prior-only split-safe 250-observation new-high Long and new-low Short breakout

trials.description: Ridge linear regression on the same four breakout, momentum and split-safe relative-volume ranks

feature_definitions.res60s1: Reused bitwise from the audited exploratory feature builder: prior 60 observed residual-return rows excluding current signal date; centered cross-sectional rank.
feature_definitions.new_high_rank: Reused bitwise from the audited exploratory feature builder: centered cross-sectional rank of positive Close_t / prior 250-observation split-safe High excess; signal-day High excluded.
feature_definitions.new_low_rank: Reused bitwise from the audited exploratory feature builder: centered cross-sectional rank of positive prior 250-observation split-safe Low / Close_t excess; signal-day Low excluded.
feature_definitions.relative_volume_change_rank: Reused bitwise from the audited exploratory feature builder: centered rank of log(split-safe raw Volume_t / prior 20-observation median), excluding current observation from median.
feature_definitions.missing_values: Per-fit training-column mean imputation and training-column standard deviation scaling only; no future rows used to estimate either.

model: Expanding-window Ridge regression predicting daily centered cross-sectional rank of official Train target Return.

parameters.target_transform: Per signal date: average percentile rank centered to [-1,1]; preserve missing target rows.
parameters.ridge_solver: Deterministic closed-form solve of (Z'Z + lambda*diag(0,1,1,1,1)) beta = Z'y.

selection_rule.primary: Descriptive comparison only; no adoption or reselection from known data.
selection_rule.diagnostic_stability: Report fold deltas; 3/4 improved folds is a necessary diagnostic threshold only.
